LanguageData.SMF_EnabledTip: Keep your camera smooth even when the game lags.
LanguageData.SMF_TpsBoostTip: Give the simulation more time without lowering camera FPS.
LanguageData.SMF_FpsTargetTip: Lower target = more time for simulation. You keep full camera FPS, but menus and animations may update less often.
LanguageData.SMF_TpsBoostUnavailable: TPS boost couldn't start. See the game log for details.
LanguageData.SMF_RendererFallback: Simply More FPS stopped after an error and is falling back to normal game rendering. Your save is unaffected.\n\nPlease copy the error and include it when reporting the issue.
